correctness.rationale: For r,s>=2 and n>=4r+3, m>=4s+3, the exact pair-extension lemma identifies masks 00/01/10/11, including both endpoint exceptions. Five fully realized pointed profiles and symmetric three-move EF strategy prove cross-radius rank-3 equivalence. Two closed r-neighborhoods cover <=4r+2 vertices, giving the sharp domination sentence. Complete small 3-round recursion certifies P11^[2] is least among path powers; endpoint containment separates long cycle powers. Independent profiles and recursion matched.
residual_risks: Proof is mathematically grounded in pair-extension lemma; repeated vertices and 00 mask handled. A finite recursion is exhaustive only for the 36 small noncomplete instances; the all-r tail is proved analytically.
